description: Create a reusable email template with {{variable}} placeholders. Idempotent by name: an existing template with the same name is updated instead (content changes snapshot a new version, old versions are retained). You have the user's codebase — match their product name, tone, and brand colors rather than writing generic copy. The reply is a summary — id, version, and the `detectedVariables` a send must supply — not the body you just sent; read the stored HTML back with volanea_get_template if you need it.

fromEmail.description: Sender address — must be on a verified domain to deliver in live mode.

name.description: Template name, e.g. 'Welcome email'. Acts as the idempotency key.

type.description: Decides who can receive it, so getting this wrong is a compliance problem rather than a cosmetic one. `transactional` reaches a recipient even when their contact is unsubscribed (password resets, receipts, verification codes). `marketing` is skipped for unsubscribed contacts and must carry an unsubscribe link. Default to `marketing` for anything promotional; use `transactional` only when the message is a direct response to something the user did.

name: volanea_create_template

code.description: Machine-readable failure code to branch on. Present only when success is false.

detectedVariables.description: Placeholders a send must supply. The body is deliberately not echoed — read it back with volanea_get_template.

version.description: Bumps when an idempotent re-create changes existing content.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when success is false.

success.description: False when the call failed; read `error` and `code` in that case.
